test_cases.title: Straight-key QSO between two units at 5 km
test_cases.setup: Validates: OPS-001, MOE-001. Phase: SAR. Article: CWHT-A-001 and CWHT-A-002, release firmware. Configuration: shipped whip antennas, straight keys, headphones; positions logged by GPS. Safety: operators hold the radio at arm's length while transmitting; both operators licensed. Environment: open flat ground, 1.5 m antenna height, 5 km separation.
procedure: Both operators call and complete a two-way exchange with call signs, a signal report and a 20-character text
test_cases.acceptance_criteria: Two-way exchange completed with at most one character error at 5 km.
